title: Six Vercel alumni have raised $235M for their own startups
summary: Six former Vercel employees have founded companies that together raised $235.1M, from Nominal's hardware testing platform to Dub's link attribution tool. Here's who they are, what they did at Vercel and what they built next.
body_markdown: Vercel’s former head of engineering went on to build a fantasy sports app in Mexico. Its first salesperson is now building infrastructure for voice agents. Between them, six Vercel alumni have raised $235M, and one of their companies raised at a $1B valuation.
